title: More likely to play?
description: Geena Davis Institute / Nielsen, Ready Players All (2025): 62% agree that they are more likely to play a video game if the playable characters are diverse; 9% disagree; the remainder, calculated as 29%, neither agree nor disagree. U.S./U.K. gamers surveyed June 10-15, 2024. The short report does not state the sample size. Stated preference is not observed play or sales.
